title: Antique Bronze Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet - 49-Inch Tall Solid Brass Towel Stand, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels organized and drying without drilling into your walls—this freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and fits beautifully in traditional bathrooms — available in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability.

  • Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stay stable on the floor with a heavy solid brass base that helps prevent tipping
  • Protect floors and counters with a felt pad that helps prevent scratching
  • Choose the look you want—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives for enduring everyday bathroom use. Complete your bathroom with matching pieces for a coordinated look.

Specs
Product type: Freestanding towel stand / swing arm towel valet
Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in x 49 in x 10.5 in
Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
Mounting: Freestanding
Base: Heavy base; felt pad included to help prevent scratching
Assembly: Some assembly required
Includes: Towel stand
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
